bonsai.method: native Bonsai on energy-selected cluster representatives

representative_kind: lowest-ProteinEBM-energy cluster member, not a structural medoid
representative_policy: One accepted lowest-ProteinEBM-energy model per assigned cluster; tied energies resolve by model ID. Physicality-rejected BioEMU2 frames are retained and explicitly flagged. These are exploratory geometry groups, not validated native states.
mask_note: Full construct A1–298 + B1–55; all residues retained; 5,000 models fit and displayed.
clustering_method_note: Accepted full-construct 4,096-D all-pair sketch, 2-D/10-D UMAP, UMAP KNN and 10-D HDBSCAN (leaf/EOM), seed 42. ProteinEBM and 0865-reference DockQ are overlays, not fit features. BioEMU2 native physicality flags are retained. Bonsai uses accepted native trees of energy-selected representatives and explicit unassigned examples. Exact whole-complex TM similarity compares one energy-selected representative per cluster. Accepted fixed-chain structural state assignments and MCMC50/DISCO50 sampling panels are available.

medoid_tm.title: TM similarity across energy-selected cluster representatives
medoid_tm.note: Whole-complex fixed-chain bidirectional USalign TM, average-length normalization, one lowest-ProteinEBM-energy model per assigned cluster. These are representative similarities, not cluster-wide distributions or structural medoids. Physicality-rejected BioEMU2 representatives remain flagged in the cluster table.
